Hi Maya / Logan — looping in a few quick legal notes after a first pass on the spreadsheet. I attached a short SOW_line_items_v2.docx with line-item descriptions we recommend. Key points: 

- Billing mapping: add a "Deliverable ID" and "Invoice description" column to the Order Form so HexaMed PMs can reconcile charges to milestones.
- Price harmonization: we can include an appendix that sets the blended rate and cites the committed token band used to compute it; call out FX treatment (USD invoicing, customer bears local VAT/GST).
- Term & termination: recommend we keep 60 days notice for termination but add a SPS (service-performance suspension) clause tied to non-payment rather than immediate termination.
- Change orders: include an explicit change-order flow (PO -> Redwood quote -> signed amendment) for any top-up capacity or scope increases. This helps avoid later disputes on retroactive charges.

I tried to keep redlines narrow so procurement can accept quickly; legal will produce a tracked-redline MSA only if HexaMed's counsel raises issues.

Suggested time for a short sync: Wed 21 Jan 2026, 11:00–11:30 PT. I'll be on the call to walk through the proposed SOW annotations.

Best,
